description: Composite Figure 4 mixing schematics, TEM micrographs and two quantitative plots. (a) is a schematic: light-blue hexagonal austenite grain crossed by one red band labelled "Deformation twins" with yellow dislocation symbols (⊥) drawn on both sides, illustrating dislocation interaction with a twin. (b) is the same hexagon with a second red band crossing the first, i.e. secondary twins subdividing the matrix. (c) is a bright-field TEM micrograph labelled "Twin" and "Twin-ε" showing parallel twin plates, with a bottom-left SAED inset indexed 000, 220, 242, 422 (and Friedel-pair spots) and a 500 nm scale bar. (d) is a TEM micrograph of intersecting parallel deformation-twin bands with a top-right SAED spot pattern whose indices are not printed, and a 200 nm scale bar. (e) plots Ratio of F/T (y, 0-7) versus True strain (x, 0.0-0.5) for two labelled series, black FeMnC and red FeMnCAl. (f) is a dual-axis plot of True stress (MPa, left axis 0-2500) and Work-hardening rate (Θ, right axis 0-3000) versus True strain (0.0-0.7), with solid stress curves and dashed work-hardening curves labelled 0Al (black) and 1.5Al (blue), and early-strain intervals marked A and B. Together the figure argues that secondary twinning refines the austenite, giving FeMnC a rising F/T and stronger work-hardening than Al-alloyed steel.
measured_quantities: ratio of F/T (fraction of twinned grains to twin thickness, dimensionless)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a schematic, not a micrograph: a single red band labelled 'Deformation twins' crosses a light-blue hexagonal grain, with yellow ⊥ symbols representing dislocations on either side.
Panel (b) adds a second red twin band crossing the first in the same hexagonal grain, illustrating secondary twins intersecting primary deformation twins.
Panel (c) is a TEM micrograph bearing the printed labels 'Twin', 'Twin-ε' and 'Twin', with a 500 nm scale bar.
The SAED inset of panel (c) shows spots indexed 000, 220, 242 and 422 (with centrosymmetric counterparts), indicating the twin-related diffraction pattern.
Panel (d) is a TEM micrograph showing parallel deformation-twin bands in a dislocation-dense matrix, with a 200 nm scale bar and an SAED inset of discrete spots whose indices are not printed.

Panel (e) plots 'Ratio of F/T' (0-7) against 'True strain' (0.0-0.5) with legend entries FeMnC (black) and FeMnCAl (red); the FeMnC curve rises steeply and the FeMnCAl curve stays near-flat below the 1 gridline.
Panel (f) is a dual-axis plot: True stress (MPa, left axis 0-2500) and Work-hardening rate (Θ, right axis 0-3000) versus True strain (0.0-0.7), with the series labelled '0Al' and '1.5Al'.

In panel (f) the 0Al work-hardening (dashed) curve falls to zero at a lower true strain than the 1.5Al dashed curve, and the 0Al true-stress curve is the first to lose load, consistent with earlier necking of the Al-free steel.
In panel (f) two vertical dashed lines bound early-strain intervals marked 'A' and 'B', within which both work-hardening curves show a pronounced initial drop.
The caption states that (a,c) and (b,d) illustrate dislocation interaction with twins and the morphology of deformation twins under TEM observation.
The caption states that (e,f) compare the F/T parameter and the work-hardening rate, and that the figure is adapted with permission from references [62,64], Copyright 2013 Elsevier.
The citing text states that with increasing plastic strain secondary twins emerge and further cut the austenite matrix into smaller regions, as shown in Figure 4b,d.

The citing text states that a higher F/T value reflects a stronger work-hardening rate in Fe-Mn-C-(Al) TWIP steels, indicating a reduced mean free path of dislocations and an improved dynamic Hall-Petch relation.
The citing text describes a 'composite effect' of hard twins embedded in a relatively soft austenite matrix of Fe-Mn-C-Al steel, which is exactly what panels (a,b) depict schematically.

subfigures.description: Schematic of a hexagonal austenite grain (light blue) traversed by one red band labelled 'Deformation twins', flanked by four yellow ⊥ dislocation symbols, illustrating dislocations meeting a single twin.

Same hexagonal grain with a second red band crossing the first at an angle, both associated with the label 'Deformation twins' and with yellow dislocation symbols on the left, illustrating secondary twins cutting the matrix.
Bright-field TEM micrograph with labels 'Twin', 'Twin-ε', 'Twin' across the field; a SAED inset in the lower-left is indexed 000, 220, 242, 422 (plus centrosymmetric spots); scale bar 500 nm.

TEM micrograph showing several parallel, closely spaced deformation-twin bands crossing a dislocation-dense matrix, with a top-right SAED spot-pattern inset (spot indices not printed) and a 200 nm scale bar.

Line plot, y = Ratio of F/T (0 to 7), x = True strain (0.0 to 0.5); black open-circle series FeMnC rises steeply from below the 1 gridline to just below the 6 gridline at 0.5, while red series FeMnCAl stays below the 1 gridline over the whole range.

Dual-axis plot: True stress (MPa) on the left axis (0-2500) and Work-hardening rate (Θ) on the right axis (0-3000) versus True strain (0.0-0.7); solid stress curves and dashed work-hardening curves are labelled 0Al (black) and 1.5Al (blue); two vertical dashed lines mark early-strain intervals labelled A (roughly 0.0-0.05) and B (roughly 0.05-0.12).
